reviewer: Single agent visual review of original images and preceding original-video sequence; no independent human or second reviewer
boxSemantics: Approximate visible body envelope including limbs, excluding racket and cast shadow; no model predictions used to draw boxes
boxPrecision: Visual pixel estimates, approximately five pixels; not a production-quality localization benchmark
identitySemantics: Clip-local visible appearance continuity only. A is pale clothing at the far end; B is white/pink clothing at the near end. Neither is a verified named or biometric identity, nor a calibrated court role.
negativeScope: Four explicit nonparticipants per sampled frame; this does not exhaustively annotate the spectators. Unmatched all-person proposals must not be scored as detector false positives.
